Party Chicken Cassarole

5 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken breasts

1 yellow onion – sliced

2t salt - divided

1 bay leaf

10 peppercorns

1 6 oz. can sliced button mushrooms – drained

1 C evaporated milk – undiluted

½ C butter or margarine

½ C flour

½ t tumeric

dash pepper

¼ t ground oregano

½ C shredded Sharp Cheddar cheese – divided

½ C slivered or whole blanched almonds

½ C slivered and toasted almonds

Cover chicken and onion with cold water in a large saucepan.

Add 1t salt, bay leaf and peppercorns.

Bring slowly to a boil.

Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until the chicken is tender.

Cool chicken in its broth, then remove skin and bones.

Cut chicken into bite-size pieces.

Strain and reserve broth.

Measure liquor from drained mushrooms and add enough chicken broth to make 3 cups.

Add evaporated milk.

Melt butter or margarine and blend in flour, 1t salt, tumeric and dash of pepper.

Addchicken broth mixture and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened. Add

Oreganoand ¼ cup cheese, then stir until cheese melts.

Add mushrooms, chicken and ½ cup blanched almonds.

Put into 3qt. casserole dish and sprinkle with toasted almonds and remaining cheese. Bake at 350 degrees until top is golden brown and sauce is bubbly. Yield 6-8servings. Serve over white yellow or brown rice.

Note: the original recipe calls for American cheese,but I prefer sharp cheddar.
